note: Four loops on paved pads along the spring-fed upper Current River, here a trout stream about 20-30 m wide; Loop 3's family site F314 and site 313 sit on its low bank (flood-prone). Electricity and frost-free water spigots stay on year-round. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $14-15 basic base, electric +14 (2026 = 2027), 50A; added 141 sites (pads 38-77 ft), showers/flush/laundry/dump/water/store, military $2, 12-month window, year-round reservations, walk-up after cutoff, 15-in-30. Riverfront -> creekside (channel ~20-30 m at the sites). PIN ~730 m off.
flags: WATERFRONT riverfront -> creekside (on-water kept, label by width): the on-water sites are Loop 3's F314 and 313 (and likely 312), which sit on the river side of the loop road ~12-25 m from the water across open, leaf-littered bank with scattered trees (leaf-off Esri imagery), pads 276.4-276.5 m against ~274.8 m at the water's edge (EPQS) - ~1.5-2 m above it, a walkable apron. The channel there measures ~22-28 m (Loop 3) and ~15-20 m beside Loop 2, ~25-30 m by Loop 4 including gravel bars - under the ~30 m line, so creekside rather than riverfront under AWH's 2026-11-01 width rule, though the water is the Current River. Loop 3's 316-322 have the loop road between them and the water (*view at best); Loop 2's 239-245 have the loop road and a picnic spot between; Loop 4's 408/411 are ~30-40 m back with a gravel path between. waterfront_evidence: 'Esri leaf-off imagery + UseDirect points 2026-11-07: Loop 3 F314/313 12-25 m from the water on open bank ~2 m above it, no road between; channel 22-28 m -> creekside'.
